name: GitHub Issue Refinement
purpose: Refine existing issues by clarifying acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, and milestones.
inputs: Issue URL with current body, labels, and milestone
Repository components, dependencies, and available verification tools
outputs: Refined issue with intent-preserving problem statement
Observable acceptance criteria, dependencies, and non-goals
stop_conditions: The issue preserves intent, has observable criteria, mapped dependencies, and explicit non-goals
